title: Modern Warfare 4: 91% positive Steam reviews from campaign early access, against 38% for Black Ops 7
first_report: Insider Gaming 2026-10-17T12:49Z (800 of 932 then); figures re-read from Steam 18 Oct 05:27Z and 05:40Z

sources.note: Black Ops 7, released 21 Nov 2025: Mostly Negative, 1,935/5,126 (37.7%)
launch October 23, 2026; campaign early access from October 16; Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation, PC, Nintendo Switch 2

claims.text: MW4 Steam user reviews Very Positive, 91% of 2,091 (morning 18 Oct)
reviews from campaign early access, from 16 Oct for digital pre-orders
launch 23 Oct per Activision; Steam shows 22 Oct US time

notes: 18 Oct: built b148 (clipcard, cold): Multiplayer trailer (the Campaign trailer is letterboxed, 2.4x) with the everyday bed, one card (our graphic) with both scores. Grammar review: no required edits; S1, S2 taken. DeepL forward pass agreed; Steam's Arabic labels match the card. Gate 05:40Z Exit A. Queued 06:30Z (earliest slot after Shrek 2 06:00Z) under the rolling queue.
18 Oct 06:39Z: PUBLISHED on X, Instagram, Threads at 06:30Z (postsListTool).
